origin: Operator challenge 2026-08-01: confidence is the source's confidence from various signals, not importance; and the Eiffel Tower entry may itself be a duplicate. Both held.

finding_1_confidence_is_per_source.claim: Overture `confidence` is a per-source value and mostly a flat default, so it is not comparable across datasets. For roughly a fifth of the corpus it is an upstream source identifier quantized into a u8.
finding_1_confidence_is_per_source.method: Seven bbox-bounded city regions, admitted rows only (names.primary NOT NULL, operating_status != permanently_closed), grouped by sources[1].dataset.
finding_1_confidence_is_per_source.invalidates: Part 6d read `Tour Eiffel confidence 0.7700, rank 202 of 299` as evidence that confidence anti-correlates with fame. The canonical Tour Eiffel is a Foursquare record and EVERY Foursquare record is 0.7700. It ranked 202nd because 201 meta records scored above another source's constant. It was never a fame measurement.
finding_1_confidence_is_per_source.survives: The operational conclusion of Part 6d still holds for a different reason: confidence cannot rank POIs. It is now known to be un-rankable because it is source-relative, not because it is inversely related to fame.

finding_1b_the_us_is_a_different_regime.claim: US metros are heavily conflated and do not show the flat-default pattern. Any rule keyed on it behaves differently there.
finding_1b_the_us_is_a_different_regime.note: An earlier reading that LEN(sources) is always 2 was a non-US artifact. In Seattle and NYC even single-source Foursquare records carry a real distribution (Seattle 24 distinct, min 0.0537; NYC 74 distinct, min 0.0587), and 0.9199 recurs as a conflation-derived mode across every dataset.

finding_2_confidence_floor_is_disqualifi.claim: No confidence floor is safe, at any value, including a meta-only floor.

landmark_class_loss_pct_by_floor._comment: percent of landmark-class records deleted; non-zero at every floor in every region

finding_2_confidence_floor_is_disqualifi.geographic_bias: At a 0.20 floor the region drop rate ranges from 1.75% (Tokyo) to 7.19% (Lagos) -- roughly 4x -- and meta is the dominant source exactly where the loss is worst (Lagos 97.8%, Sao Paulo 90.6%, Mumbai 83.9% of records).
finding_2_confidence_floor_is_disqualifi.low_confidence_is_regionally_different: Paris/Berlin sub-0.20 skews to B2B services and individual practitioners. Lagos and Mumbai sub-0.20 is dominated by real small retail (Aman Footwear 0.0549, Bhavani General Store 0.3004, a church_cathedral named Church at 0.0960). Low confidence there tracks thinness of corroborating evidence, not fakeness.
finding_2_confidence_floor_is_disqualifi.recommendation: Do not ship a confidence floor. If a junk filter is wanted, the axis worth probing is absence of corroboration in combination (category-vs-name coherence, missing address freeform, single-source AND low confidence). That combination was not measured.

finding_3_the_eiffel_tower_is_its_own_co.claim: q=Eiffel Tower is not losing to hotels. It is losing to itself.

wider_truth_set._comment: 12 km radius, any category, name fully consumed by landmark name-forms plus geo/language filler

duplicate_shapes: transliteration (Torre Eiffel, Eiffelturm, Turnul Eiffel, Eifel Torenparijs)
typos (Efiel Tower, Paris Toureffeil, Toul Eiffel, Tour Eifell)
parts of the structure (Sommet de la Tour Eiffel, Tour Eiffel - 1er Etage, Eiffel Tower Second Floor)

finding_4_simple_dedup_does_not_reach_it.claim: A simple heuristic clears about a third of the clear outliers and does not fix q=Eiffel Tower. The fuzzy variant that would is unshippable.
finding_4_simple_dedup_does_not_reach_it.note_on_radius: At R <= 500 m the heuristic is inert -- it removes 1 of 87. The duplicates are not co-located.

jaro_winkler_inversion._comment: The threshold would have to exceed 0.958 and be at most 0.830 simultaneously. Jaro-Winkler's prefix bonus is structurally wrong here: shared prefixes are how distinct places are named.

must_not_merge.pair: Statue of Liberty / Statue of Liberty Deli

what_does_work.category_gate: Exact name + tight landmark category + R=500 m across six cities gives 31 merges over 64 records, all reviewed, all genuine same-place duplicates (Chateau de Versailles x3, Empire State Building x2, Citicorp Center x2). False positives ~0-13%, all on generic single-token names (Home, Paris, Casa, Pavillon) that a stopword or min-token guard would remove.
what_does_work.chains_are_handled_by_the_category_gate_: Without it, R=500 m in NYC merges Western Union (2409 pairs), Starbucks (1845), LibertyX ATM (1624). Broadening the category set to include travel/tours re-admits them (Hertz x6 over 922 m).

named_businesses_containing_the_landmark.pair: Tour Eiffel / Brasserie de la Tour Eiffel
Tour Eiffel / Bureau de Gustave Eiffel

finding_4_simple_dedup_does_not_reach_it.representative_selection_caveat: Highest-confidence fails Paris, picking `France Eiffel` (0.9697, 912 m) over `Tour Eiffel` (0.7700, 13 m) -- a direct consequence of finding 1. Foursquare is flat 0.7700 in Paris/Tokyo/Rome but genuinely distributed in Seattle (296 distinct) and NYC (755), so `highest confidence` works in the US and fails in Europe/Japan for the same source. Not a rule that ships globally.
finding_4_simple_dedup_does_not_reach_it.decisive_number: Exact-name dedup at UNLIMITED radius still leaves 53 distinct Eiffel Tower name-forms against a head cap of 10.
finding_4_simple_dedup_does_not_reach_it.recommendation: Measured and deferred. Shipping the simple version buys a modest data cleanup, not a fix for q=Eiffel Tower. The structural fix remains Stage 3 famous-unique admission plus a real fame signal.

landmine_normaliser.claim: The obvious normaliser destroys CJK names and the failure is invisible in Latin-script testing.
landmine_normaliser.wider_measurement: 292285 of 420726 Tokyo records (69.47%) on a 15 km bbox
landmine_normaliser.consequence: Under exact-name equality that is one cluster containing most of Tokyo.
landmine_normaliser.fix: Use [^\p{L}\p{N}], which RE2 supports in DuckDB 1.5.5. Measured empties then fall to 0.0007% in Tokyo, and distinct names rise from 88208 to 365948.
landmine_normaliser.applies_regardless: Worth recording even if dedup is never built -- any name normalisation in the pipeline has this hazard.

not_measured: No planet-wide or country-wide scan. Seven city bboxes for confidence, six for duplicates, one release.
No ground-truth gazetteer. Real-place judgements are qualitative from name/category/address, except the four brand cases verified against known street addresses.
No token-set/Jaccard, trigram, phonetic, or embedding matching -- only exact and Jaro-Winkler. A token-set rule would likely beat JW on the `Placa de X` failure mode and is the obvious next probe.
No transliteration, so cross-script duplicates were never merge candidates. They are a large share of the residual.
How often the confidence tie-break actually decides a cap eviction. That is Wave C and remains unmeasured.
Whether low-confidence meta records are geometric duplicates of higher-confidence records, which would change the floor cost calculus.
Rural and small-town areas. All bboxes are metro.
